name: navigator-no-unguarded-main-git
body:
The distributed `codebase-navigator` holds a git grant set free of any form that rewrites the main checkout's branch refs or moves its HEAD/working tree and bypasses the verify gate. Integration into main happens ONLY through `apg project merge <name>` (verify gate → merge → main rebuild → self-clean).

The template's `permissions` array (`opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`) carries `shell`-action rules. A grant the spec calls read-only admits zero ref-writing forms.

The grant set (per verb):
- `git status *`, `git diff *`, `git log *` are granted read-only inspection.
- `git branch --show-current` is granted — it prints the checked-out branch and takes zero ref-writing option.
- `git worktree list *` is granted — read-only worktree listing.
- `git rebase *` is granted for the worktree-only sync the agent-builder main-flow step performs (rebasing the project worktree onto main); the template states it runs with cwd INSIDE the project worktree and keeps the main checkout out of the flow.

Every other git verb sits outside the grant set:
- `git merge` sits outside the grant set — merging into main is `apg project merge`'s job, behind the verify gate.
- `git checkout` and `git switch` sit outside the grant set — they move the main checkout's HEAD and working tree; the flow reaches its goals with the project branch in its worktree and `apg project start` creating it.
- `git worktree add` and `git worktree remove` sit outside the grant set — `apg project start` and `apg project merge`'s self-clean own them.
- A blanket `git branch *` sits outside the grant set because it admits ref-writing forms — `git branch -f <branch> <sha>`, `git branch -D`, `git branch -m`. The exact pattern `git branch --show-current` is the sole granted `git branch` form: the branch/worktree identity comes from `apg project start`'s printed path and `git status`, so a grant the spec calls read-only admits zero rewriting of a branch ref.

Read-only caveat: `git diff *` and `git log *` admit the output-redirect option `--output=<file>`, which writes an arbitrary file (including inside the main checkout). `--output=<file>` is FORBIDDEN on every granted git verb; the navigator runs `git diff` and `git log` to stdout only. This is a prose-enforced form (the glob reaches zero exclusion of it), recorded in `requirements.constraint.main-integration-via-merge-gate-only` alongside the worktree-only `git rebase` rule.

Acceptance criteria:
- The navigator template's `permissions` array carries `shell` rules granting exactly `git status *`, `git diff *`, `git log *`, `git branch --show-current`, `git worktree list *`, and the worktree-only `git rebase *`; it grants zero of `git merge`, `git checkout`, `git switch`, a blanket `git branch`, and `git worktree add`/`git worktree remove`.
- The navigator passes `--output=<file>` (or any output-redirecting option) to a granted git verb zero times; `git diff`/`git log` output goes to stdout only, and `requirements.constraint.main-integration-via-merge-gate-only` states this forbidden form and records it as a prose-enforced form exactly as it does for the worktree-only `git rebase` rule.
- Its body states that main is integrated only via `apg project merge`, and that `git rebase` runs only inside the project worktree for the agent-builder sync step.
- `AGENTS.md` states the same (its Worktree isolation section calls a blanket `git branch` a read-only verb zero times).
- Scope: `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`, `AGENTS.md`; the repo's own `.opencode/agents/**` sit outside this requirement.
